value.name: Miles shakes Herb's hand
value.description: Miles accepts Herb's offered hand and completes a clammy handshake.
evidence: Miles takes the man's offered hand, withered and roped with veins, and accepts its clammy shake.

value.name: Herb speaks weakly
value.description: Herb begins speaking in a strained, labored voice, addressing Miles as counsel.
evidence: VOICE -- Counseluh, you are the engine that drives this foim --
He leans back in his chair, breathing heavily

value.name: Herb reveals frailty
value.description: Herb's heavy breathing, dry lips, and tinted glasses emphasize his ailing condition.
evidence: He leans back in his chair, breathing heavily, and runs a tongue over his sandpapery lips.
He is wearing oversize Swifty- Lazar style glasses, heavily tinted in spite of the dark.

value.name: Miles thanks Herb
value.description: After Herb's pause, Miles responds politely by thanking him.
evidence: At length MILES Thank you Herb.
